UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player account profile storing username and favorite game IDs.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Display username chosen by the player.

favorites.description: List of favorited game IDs (up to 1000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

GameSave.title: GameSave
GameSave.description: Saved session metadata, playtime, and checkpoint note for a single game.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

gameId.description: Game identifier matching the catalog ID.

savedAt.description: Client epoch milliseconds timestamp when progress was saved.

note.description: Optional checkpoint note or export code.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last save sync.

GameStorageEntry.title: GameStorageEntry
GameStorageEntry.description: Per-game localStorage key/value pair synced under a user's account.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

gameId.description: Game identifier associated with the scoped localStorage entry.

storageValue.description: String value persisted for the scoped localStorage key.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last storage sync.

GameSuggestion.title: GameSuggestion
GameSuggestion.description: Player-submitted suggestion for a game or website to add, readable and removable only by the owner.

siteUrl.description: Optional http(s) URL to the game or site.

notes.description: Optional player notes about the suggestion.

submittedByUid.description: Submitter Firebase UID or 'guest' when unauthenticated.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the suggestion was submitted.

OwnerLock.title: OwnerLock
OwnerLock.description: Immutable singleton binding site owner privileges exclusively to the TheGGhampter account.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the claimed TheGGhampter owner account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when owner lock was initialized.

DeletedAccount.title: DeletedAccount
DeletedAccount.description: Revocation marker recorded when the owner deletes an account via the control panel.

username.description: Username of the deleted account at deletion time.

deletedBy.description: UID of the owner who deleted the account.

deletedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was deleted.

ConnectionCheck.title: ConnectionCheck
ConnectionCheck.description: Public read-only connectivity probe document at /test/connection.

/users/{userId}.description: Private player profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/gameSaves/{gameId}.description: Per-game save metadata, playtime, and checkpoint notes owned by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/gameStorage/{entryId}.description: Per-game localStorage key/value backups owned by {userId}.

/gameSuggestions/{suggestionId}.description: Player-submitted game/site suggestions visible and manageable exclusively by TheGGhampter.

/config/{docId}.description: Singleton owner lock document (/config/owner) binding admin privileges to TheGGhampter.

/deletedAccounts/{userId}.description: Deleted account revocation markers written by the owner control panel.

/test/{docId}.description: Server connectivity check endpoint allowing single-document get on /test/connection only.
